description: Hi, I'm Ved, an engineering student working on drone/UAV systems. We're building the CLPS Lunar Mission Browser: a web tool to compare lunar south pole landing sites and dates by visualizing Sun and Earth positions vs. the horizon. Looking for: frontend dev (React/JS), data viz (D3/Three.js), Python for ephemerides (SpiceyPy/Astropy), and UI/UX or video skills. Fully virtual, beginners welcome!
